g.text: Throughput: aisleflow wins where aisles are scarce, and loses where they are not

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Taller is better: tasks delivered per 1000 timesteps, so 155 means 155 tasks out of every 1000 steps of simulated time.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each map shows the best aisleflow configuration on that map, named under its bar, with a permutation test against plain PIBT above it.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Aisleflow is ahead on 2 of these 3 maps (bottleneck, corridors) by 22-39%, and behind on medium by 15%.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Both published baselines are far behind on every map, which is the comparison the next figure is about.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781
